subject: Runway bridge: metric-backed topup proposal for HaloHealth pilot
messages:
From: Cara Maldonado <cara@halohealth.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: HaloHealth Procurement <procurement@halohealth.io>, Evan Brooks <evan@halohealth.io>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 12:05:00 -0400
Subject: Runway bridge: metric-backed topup proposal for HaloHealth pilot

Hi Stephanie,

Quick note from our side — we hit a blocker on the final data ingestion and that pushed our evaluation timeline out by about 2–3 weeks. Our execs are asking whether we can extend the current time-boxed pilot rather than restart a new one.

We'd like to propose a trade: either a short extension on the timebox or converting the remaining days into convertible credits that get applied on contract signature. To make it fair for Redwood, we were thinking about a metric-backed structure (e.g., 10% rebate on committed OTE if we exceed X generated sessions / Y tokens during the extended window).

Can Redwood: 1) grant a short extension (2–3 weeks), and/or 2) escrow a small credit amount that is refundable/convertible on conversion metrics? If you have a short term-sheet or an example cadence for these kinds of deals that would help.

We need to present options to procurement tomorrow — any fast path you can offer would be appreciated.

Thanks,
Cara
Cara Maldonado
Head of Product
HaloHealth
[Sent from mobile]
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Cara Maldonado <cara@halohealth.io>
Cc: procurement@halohealth.io, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Runway bridge: metric-backed topup proposal for HaloHealth pilot

Thanks for the note, Cara — totally understand the timing hit and we can be flexible. Two pragmatic options we use often for short runway pushes: 

Option A — Short extension + conversion rebate
- 2-week extension at no additional charge
- If HaloHealth converts to a committed plan within 30 days after the extended window AND usage metrics exceed the agreed threshold (we'll use the attached template to codify X/Y), Redwood provides a 10% usage credit on the first month invoice (applied as a one-time billing credit).

Option B — Escrowed/topup credits (reduces risk for both sides)
- 3-week extension funded by a small upfront retainer (converted to customer credit on conversion).
- If conversion occurs and metric thresholds are met, the retainer is credited 100%; if not, 50% converts to support/engineering time and 50% retained to cover capacity reservation.

I've attached a short term-sheet (sprint-topup-term-sheet.pdf) and the halo-metrics-template.xlsx to make thresholds explicit. We will need a quick sign-off from Finance on Option B (escrow/retainer flow) — I’m looping in Priyom and David to confirm viability.

If procurement needs a one-line agreement to move fast, we can prepare a 1‑page amendment and route it through DocuSign today. What timeframe do you need for approval?

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sprint-topup-term-sheet.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]
[Attachment: halo-metrics-template.xlsx (Excel, 8KB)]
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Runway bridge: metric-backed topup proposal for HaloHealth pilot

Quick finance note — we can support Option B (retainer → credit conversion) with the following guardrails: 
- Require 50% of the agreed topup as an upfront non-refundable retainer that is applied as credit if conversion happens. The remaining 50% can be invoiced on signature of the amendment.
- If thresholds are met, full retainer converts to customer credit. If thresholds are not met, 50% of the retainer is retained as a capacity reservation fee and the remainder is applied to an extended support block (so customer still gets value).
- For accounting and internal approval, please capture the exact metric definitions in the term-sheet (usage window, token/session counts, and a single data pull source).

I recommend we position this as a hybrid: 2-week extension + retainer option only if procurement insists on more runway. Keep the ask to procurement simple (approve amendment + 50% retainer authorization).

Priyom
Priyom Das
Head of Revenue Finance
Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Cara Maldonado <cara@halohealth.io>, HaloHealth Procurement <procurement@halohealth.io>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 10:25:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Hybrid runway path — 2 week extension + retainer conversion option

Cara — thanks for the quick coordination last week. To make procurement's life easy, here is the final, operationalized offer: 

Summary (final offer)
- 2-week extension to the current pilot at no additional charge (automatic on counter-signature of this amendment).
- If HaloHealth requests 3 weeks instead, Redwood will require a 50% upfront retainer (see below).
- Retainer terms (only applies if procurement chooses the 3-week path): 50% upfront, refundable/convertible as customer credit on conversion if the agreed metric thresholds are met within the 30-day post-extension window. If metrics are not met, 50% of the retainer converts to capacity reservation fee, remaining to support hours (per Priyom's note).
- Metric rebate: if usage exceeds the thresholds in halo-metrics-template.xlsx, Redwood will apply a 10% usage credit on the first paid invoice post-conversion.

Action items to move forward quickly
1) Please confirm whether you want the 2-week no-charge extension (fast) or the 3-week retainer-backed extension (requires procurement approval and payment).
2) If you choose the retainer path, we will send the amendment via DocuSign for signature and invoice 50% of the retainer immediately.
3) Finalize the metric thresholds in the attached template and return with a sign-off.

Links and attachments
- Term sheet: sprint-topup-term-sheet.pdf (attached)
- Metrics template: halo-metrics-template.xlsx (attached)
- DocuSign (amendment): https://app.docusign.com/someDocLink/HALO-POC-392
- HubSpot deal: https://redwood.hubspot.com/deal/HALO-POC-392

If procurement wants a short phone call to close this today I can do 30m — let me know what time works. Requesting a response by EOD 2026-07-08 to keep engineering scheduling aligned.

Best,
—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Manager, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
